## What is still open
- Tom requested changes on #423: split the module move from the lint fixes, since the 1,900-line diff hides the real changes. He'll approve both PRs today if you send two [4].
- Fernhill IT's SSO walkthrough is Thursday 10am NY time on staging with their Okta tenant. Priya runs the demo and you just need to be on the call [1]. Signature validation was due on staging by Wednesday EOD, and #418 is now merged and goes out with tonight's staging deploy [3].
- The replay cache for assertion IDs is still in-memory only. You planned to move it to Redis today, since with several pods a replay could succeed on another one [1][2].

## What changed
- Maya approved and merged #418, the signature verification, and thanked you for the signature-wrapping test. She left one non-blocking nit on an error message wording [3].
- Rachel reported that the Zest Grocers CSV export times out (#424, ~230k rows, used every Monday). Tom took it and will move it to the job queue with an emailed link [5].

## What you did
- You fixed the flaky `test_acs_rejects_expired_assertion` by freezing time, and did the same for two other sleep-based tests. You also cleared the ruff 0.8 and mypy warnings in `kestrel/auth` and split `saml_utils.py` into a `saml/` package. All of it is in #423 [1][4].
- You built SAML signature verification (SHA-256 and above only, no SHA-1 flag) plus replay protection, and opened #418 [2].
